title: CUADebug: Diagnosing and Repairing Computer-Use Agent Failures
abstract: arXiv:2608.02643v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) interact with graphical interfaces through screenshots and low-level mouse and keyboard actions, yet the causal error may precede the terminal failure. We present CUADebug, a framework for localizing root causes in CUA trajectories and guiding re-execution. CUADebug includes a five-category, 30-subtype taxonomy; CUAErrorBench, a benchmark of 204 failed OSWorld trajectories with human root-cause annotations; and CUADebugger, a ReAct-style agent for root-cause analysis (RCA). CUADebugger iteratively selects trajectory steps, inspects paired before/after screenshots and action traces, and submits a structured diagnosis containing the causal step, taxonomy label, grounded evidence, and correction. CUADebugger performs RCA without per-trajectory human intervention; human annotations are used to evaluate RCA predictions and, in controlled re-rollout comparisons, to fix restart points. translated_title: CUADebug：诊断与修复计算机使用代理的失败
translated_abstract: 计算机使用代理通过截图和低层次的鼠标与键盘操作与图形界面进行交互，然而导致失败的因果错误可能发生在最终失败之前。我们提出了CUADebug，一个用于在CUA轨迹中定位根本原因并指导重新执行的框架。CUADebug包括一个五类别、三十子类型的错误分类体系；CUAErrorBench，一个包含204条带有根因人工标注的OSWorld失败轨迹的基准数据集；以及CUADebugger，一个用于根因分析（RCA）的ReAct风格代理。CUADebugger迭代地选择轨迹步骤，检查成对的操作前后截图和动作轨迹，并提交包含因果步骤、分类标签、证据支撑和修正方案的结构化诊断。CUADebugger无需对每条轨迹进行人工干预即可执行根因分析；人工标注用于评估RCA预测，并在受控的重新执行对比实验中用于固定重启点。任务推理与……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了CUADebug框架，通过错误分类体系、带人工标注的失败轨迹基准和ReAct风格的调试代理，自动定位计算机使用代理失败轨迹中的根本原因并指导修复重执行。
en_tdlr: We present CUADebug, a framework that automatically localizes root causes in computer-use agent failure trajectories via an error taxonomy, a human-annotated benchmark, and a ReAct-style debugging agent that guides re-execution.
